points: 500 technical decision makers surveyed in September 2026; 68% call themselves maturing or mature in AI
Only 7% have 70% or more of their data cleaned, prepared and classified for AI
Only 28% on average have quantified AI ROI; Microsoft Fabric the most used lakehouse at 49%
read: Komprise press release (GlobeNewswire), 15 October 2026; vendor survey, claims
take: Another vendor survey confirms the gap: maturity claims run ahead of data preparation and measured ROI. Budget for classification of unstructured data first.
title: Komprise survey: over 90% say their data is not AI-ready
